scope.source_inputs: Only original factory/initial/cfg/language and actual site ordinal determine each NativeValue/Words. CommonWords is their dependent finite direct sum, not an input evaluator/Env/completed future table.
scope.literal_site_grade: DFinsupp exact ordinal labels and component lapply retain each site's full Finsupp Expr coefficient word at packet.grade. sourceWord uses lsingle of literal expression coefficient1; no sorting by scalar value or collapsed State/native carrier occurs.
scope.actual_inventory: oldEnvironment is installed readRaw(C.rawAtStop).environment and installed_environment consumes CP116 installed_request. actualIncrement is the same C.materialAtStop.increment, from original Installation.residualAt: frame.environment(old.root.emitted current)-registered Env.
scope.ordered_mixed: nativeInventory is original updateInventory = old evaluation × effect evaluator. actual_inventory_square uses original evaluation_liftMap. Existing pairBilinear retains f(a,db), f(da,b), f(da,db) as separate terms; both ordered mixed directions and the joint increment remain present.
scope.compatible_generated: Data fields are actual prefixEvaluator and projection restriction. Compatible is proved from the same indexed source observations by ext/rfl, not passed to a constructor. The restriction drops the last observation and is explicitly a prefix restriction.
scope.complete_fibre: Existing CofinalKernel.zero_iff gives completion zero iff every site inventory is zero. Applying to left-right gives exact joint fibre; original inventory_fibre_generated expresses every site component difference via liftMap into the full pairEnvironment relationMap range. Literal coefficients remain in CommonWords and the relation representatives; a genuine observation kernel remains permitted.
scope.same_material_update: updatedEnvironment is original N.input(C.materialAtStop).environment. updated_environment derives old+actualIncrement. updateMorphism generatorMap=id and stageMap=additionReadout derive both naturality fields; original completionMorphism_source_naturality gives whole coefficient completion update.
scope.source_word_separation: registeredWord uses actual installed registered AST; residualWord uses N.expression of this local material. They are separate definitions, and actual_residual_inventory obtains old zero/effect from N.old_value and N.updated_value on the same material.
scope.authority: Original CP116 actual source root/current/material/owner and full runtime history remain. This mathematical coefficient producer does not advance a controller or identify full State Carrier with native coefficient words.
scope.runtime_next_boundary: Prefixes restrict source observations at fixed original site labels; updateMorphism uses the same material Env+increment and identity generator. No cross-grade runtime-next/liftAction or its quotient-kernel stability is claimed.
scope.real_kernel_controls: Formal const0 word is nonzero while its completionMap is zero. Site labels and registered/local residual words remain distinct. Scenario site_old/site_updated/site_inventory derive actual source (0,(1,0))/(0,0), with no nonzero input premise.
scope.trust: Both own source bodies freshly kernel checked; complete new production and all named generic/scenario helper type/value DAG audited.41 public raw type/value expressions and axioms independently read and printed; frozen gate has zero printed mouths. Only formally signed CP116 dependencies reused, no CP118 construction source or OLean consumed.
